name: Chimbote
sourceReview: First-party sources evidence Municipalidad Provincial del Santa/COFOPRI cadastral custody and the national SUNARP BGR parcel viewer. The BGR requires identity/CAPTCHA access and timed out anonymously; no public parcel geometry, schema, CRS, or stable native identity was verified. No sample GeoJSON was retained.

queryReview.englishDiscovery: Completed; official SUNARP, MEF, GeoPeru/IDEP, and BGR sources found.
queryReview.localLanguageDiscovery: Completed in Spanish; first-party Municipalidad Provincial del Santa and COFOPRI cadastral custody/procedure sources found.

requestOutcomes: Official SUNARP service documentation and municipal pages returned 200. Anonymous GET to the official BGR viewer timed out after 20 seconds; anonymous SICAR GET timed out after 15 seconds. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA interaction, private token, TLS exception, or bypass was used. No parcel query was attempted after access remained unavailable; this is not evidence of citywide absence.
safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identity if later documented
scopeLimits: Local municipal/COFOPRI cadastral custody is evidenced, but no open parcel layer/schema/CRS/native identity was verified.
The official MEF cadastral plan is referential urban land-value cartography, not a bounded native parcel feature response, and was not converted into polygons.
No owner, titleholder, address, contact, tax/account, legal/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
No authentication, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter review.
uncertainty: No claim is made about exact-point parcel presence, citywide coverage, map extent, geometry availability, or legal/title completeness. A timeout, login wall, or unavailable UI does not establish absence.
